subject: LumenHealth POC — kickoff, hands-on, and capacity triage
messages:
From: Nate O'Connor <nate.oconnor@lumenhealth.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Mar 2028 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: LumenHealth POC — kickoff and hands-on scheduling

Sergio / Marissa,

Thanks for the quick intro call earlier. We're excited to get a POC going to validate routing quality and token economics for our clinical summarization workflow. High-level asks from our side: a hands-on kickoff with prompt review, routing configuration, and a short load test to validate throughput and burst behavior. We'll need to decide whether to run this on Redwood Hosted first or push a Dedicated trial (we have procurement + security questions on Dedicated).

Can we get a 90-minute kickoff where:
- 30m prompts & routing review (our prompt library + expected token lengths)
- 30m hands-on connection & test prompts
- 30m capacity discussion (rate limits, token budgets, quota bump steps)

Availability next week: any day Tues-Fri (3/21-3/24) morning PST. Attendees from our side: me (Nate), Ryan Ho (tech lead), and Karen Lim (security lead). Procurement may pop in depending on Dedicated conversation.

Also please send any pre-read or capacity template to complete so we can estimate token budgets.

Thanks,
Nate
Nate O'Connor
Director, Platform Engineering
LumenHealth

Attachment: initial_scope.docx (stub)
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood-inference.com>
To: Nate O'Connor <nate.oconnor@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Mar 2028 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: LumenHealth POC — kickoff and hands-on scheduling

Hi Nate — great to hear this. 90 minutes sounds right. I'm copying Priyom (solutions eng) to run the load/routing side and Marissa (CS) to own the onboarding cadence and procurement touchpoints.

Proposed slots (PST):
- Wed 3/22, 9:30–11:00am
- Thu 3/23, 8:30–10:00am

I'll attach a short kickoff agenda and a blank capacity matrix for you to fill (token lengths, expected QPS, sample prompts). If you can populate the matrix ahead of the session we'll use it to size whether Hosted will suffice or if we should open a Dedicated trial window (+ request quota bump).

Agenda (attached demo_agenda.pdf):
- Intros & success criteria (10m)
- Prompt walkthrough + expected tokens (20m)
- Integration & hands-on demo (30m)
- Routing & batching strategy (15m)
- Capacity plan & next steps (15m)

Attachments: demo_agenda.pdf, capacity_matrix.csv

If those slots don't work send a few alternatives and we'll adjust.

Cheers,
Sergio
Sr. Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood-inference.com>
To: Nate O'Connor <nate.oconnor@lumenhealth.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood-inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Mar 2028 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: LumenHealth POC — kickoff and hands-on scheduling

Thanks — quick checklist from my side so the hands-on is effective:

Can you confirm for the matrix:
- Typical prompt length (tokens): e.g., avg 600, 95th 1400
- Expected concurrency / sustained RPS during the load test (eg 5 rps sustained, 25 rps burst)
- Sequence length for KV cache considerations (max context length)
- Any model preference (e.g., Llama2-70B, RedW-13B) or quantized variant

Operational notes:
- If Hosted makes sense for initial validation we can run a 2-week smoke window and handle quota bumps via support (fast).
- For Dedicated trial we'll need a short procurement window (~7–10 business days) and network allowlist (we'll provide IP/CIDR).
- For load tests we'll recommend a warmup plan (10–15min gradual ramp) and a burst cap to avoid noisy neighbor issues.

Proposed testing instrumentation I'll bring: request tracing link, token/cost dashboard, and a short test harness we can run from your environment.

I'll plan to run the routing/load test portion and will need Ryan's access (or a shell account) during the hands-on.

If Wed 3/22 9:30 works for you we'll lock it.

—Priyom
Solutions Engineering, Redwood Inference
From: Nate O'Connor <nate.oconnor@lumenhealth.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood-inference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood-inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Mar 2028 11:16:00 -0700
Subject: Re: LumenHealth POC — kickoff and hands-on scheduling

Thanks — quick update: 3/22 morning conflicts on our side (exec all-hands moved). Can we shift to Thurs 3/23 at 8:30am PST instead? That works for Ryan and Karen.

Attendees now confirmed: Nate O'Connor (me), Ryan Ho (ryan.ho@lumenhealth.com - tech lead), Karen Lim (security), and potentially one person from procurement.

Attached a short network checklist (network_requirements.xlsx) — Karen wanted to pre-check firewall/allowlist needs given Dedicated is on the table. We'll fill the capacity_matrix before the session; Ryan will share sample prompts ahead of time.

If you can send an invite for Thu 3/23 8:30–10:00am PST with a Zoom link that would be ideal.

Best,
Nate

Attachment: network_requirements.xlsx

Subject: Re: LumenHealth POC — kickoff and hands-on scheduling

Hi Nate — confirmed for Thu 3/23, 8:30–10:00am PST. Calendar invite and Zoom link below; I also added a HubSpot event and linked the capacity template. Please RSVP when you have the matrix filled.

Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/987654321
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DL-2028-0173
Pre-reads attached: demo_agenda.pdf, capacity_matrix.csv

Quick operational notes so everyone is aligned before the kickoff:
- If LumenHealth wants a Dedicated trial, we'll request a 2-week Dedicated window. Procurement/Security should expect SOC2 evidence and an allowlist for IPs. We'll kick a procurement packet after the session.
- For Hosted first-run: we can approve a quota bump (tokens/day) ahead of the load test; please provide the filled capacity_matrix and expected burst patterns.
- Priyom will run routing & load verification; Sergio will lead the prompt review.

If Karen needs a separate security deep-dive, we can schedule a follow-up next week (30–45m).

Thanks — looking forward to the session.

—Marissa
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
